brief:
Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya said the movement has proposed mediating between warring parties in Yemen and hopes the offer will gain acceptance, the Maan news agency reported.

Al-Hayya did not specify which Yemeni factions Hamas aimed to mediate between or provide details on when the proposal was made. The statement represents an attempt by the Palestinian resistance movement to expand its diplomatic role beyond Palestinian affairs.
title: Hamas political chief offers to mediate Yemen conflict
